artworks.title: Camma and Sinorix
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ann and Matthew Nimetz
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a gathering with a mythical theme. The image shows a group of figures in dynamic motion. To the left, there is a circular temple-like structure with Corinthian columns, inside of which a statue stands prominently. Figures are congregated around the temple, gesturing and engaged with one another. To the right, a figure on a chariot drawn by horses is depicted in a dramatic pose. The background shows an architectural and natural setting with ancient buildings and trees. The detailed line work creates a sense of depth and vibrancy across the tableau.

artworks.title: Virgin of the Immaculate Conception
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown washes over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert B.Loper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a celestial scene. The scene depicts various draped and winged figures. The central figure is seated on a cloud, surrounded by accompanying figures, possibly angels, indicated by their wings. Soft wisps and swirls around the figures imply clouds. The use of light and shadow gives a sense of depth and movement. The soft lines and subtle color washes contribute to the dreamlike quality of the composition.

artworks.title: Hercules and Lichas, Seen from the Front
artworks.artist: Pietro Fontana and Giovanni Folo, after Antonio Canova
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts two human figures. The central figure is a muscular, bearded man standing in an aggressive posture, gripping the leg of a smaller figure who appears distressed. The smaller figure is upside down, held by one leg, with sprawling arms and a pained expression. Both figures are nude with detailed anatomical features. The sculpture is monochrome, likely made from stone or plaster, with a smooth texture resembling marble. The larger figure stands on a lion-headed base, adding to the sculpture's grandeur. It is placed on a plain background.

artworks.title: Funerary Monument to Horatio Nelson
artworks.medium: engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture is a grand tomb or sepulcher dedicated to Admiral Nelson. It features a central seated female figure adorned with a crown, holding a scepter and a wreath. The tomb is rectangular with relief sculptures on its sides depicting various figures in classical attire. The sculpture is made of stone or marble, with a monochrome appearance in varying shades of grey. Surrounding the central figure are decorative motifs such as lions, garlands, and flame-topped torches. A plaque at the base contains inscriptions in a classical style. The structure is elevated on a stepped plinth.

artworks.title: Bust of a Young Woman with a Turban
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual is facing slightly to their left with their head turned towards the viewer, looking directly ahead. Their facial features include large eyes, a straight nose, and lips slightly parted with a neutral expression. The person has short, curly hair around the forehead and sides, mostly covered by a cloth or turban. They wear a draped garment resembling classical attire, loosely wrapped around their shoulders, with no visible jewelry or objects. The background features simple, subtle shading with no distinct elements, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Bust of Francesco I d'Este
artworks.artist: Giovanni Boldini, after Gian Lorenzo Bernini
artworks.medium: brown and blue washes on ivory wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Patrons' Permanent Fund

artworks.title: Workmen before an Inn
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash and watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Nell Weidenhammer Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling street scene in a village or town. The drawing captures a lively scene with various activities taking place. A horse-drawn cart is situated to the right, barrels are being managed. The streets are cobbled, and there are architectural buildings in the background with steeply pitched roofs and chimney stacks. Figures are engaged in different activities along the street, tending to the barrels, bending down, and approaching a stall with goods. Foliage hangs over the structures, and the mood is busy and everyday. The drawing is detailed and intricate, with careful use of lines and a subtle color palette.

artworks.title: Herdsman on Horseback (Buttero a cavallo)
artworks.medium: etching on textured wove paper (artist's proof)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows the back of a person seated on a horse. The person is sitting upright on the horse with their back to the viewer. The person wears a hat and a jacket. The horse's top part is also visible. The background features a textured landscape with lines suggesting a path and distant forms. The artwork emphasizes the lines and movement of both the rider and the horse.

artworks.title: a) On Maneuvers (recto); b) On Maneuvers (verso) (Alle Manovre)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (proof impressions on recto and verso)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows horses and a person among rugged terrain. The horizon is subtly depicted, blending the sky and land. The horses are portrayed with expressive lines, while a person stands with their back turned near tent-like structures. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray and off-white, giving a vintage feel. The print has a textured appearance.

artworks.title: Cavalry Soldier (Soldato di cavalleria)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (proof, before corners of plate were beveled)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a rider on horseback on a sloped track with trees in the distance. The etching features fine lines detailing the horse, rider, and landscape. The color scheme is black, gray, and white, highlighting the contrast between the sunlit path and shaded areas. The horse and rider are detailed on the bright path, with the road curving into a shadowed area lined by trees and dense grass.

artworks.title: Path in Parco delle Cascine (Un viale interno delle Cascine)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (artist's proof)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a wooded area with a path leading into the forest. Trees fill the scene, their branches forming a canopy. The style features detailed black lines depicting the tangled branches in a pen and ink aesthetic. The monochromatic palette includes black, gray, and white tones. The ground shows patches of light and shadow, resembling snow or undergrowth. The path disappears into the dense trees, creating a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Little Donkey in Sunlight (Somarello al sole)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (working proof, before reduction of the plate)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mule in a rustic setting. The image features a mule with a saddle against a textured background that resembles a rough wall. The artwork is created using etching techniques, emphasizing line detail and texture. The overall tone is one of solitude and simplicity, with earthy tones dominating the composition. The mule's posture and the shadow on the ground contribute to the realism of the scene. Details such as the fur and muscles of the mule are intricately depicted, adding to the lifelike quality of the animal.

artworks.title: Interior of a Stable with Horses (Interno di stalla con cavalli)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (artist's proof, before beveling of the plate)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stable interior with two horses. The image depicts a rustic stable, where two horses are positioned within individual stalls, both feeding from mangers. The line work is intricate, with a crosshatching technique used to render the darkness and shadows of the stable interior. The foreground features uneven ground and a vertical beam as a partition between the areas occupied by the horses. The drawing's style emphasizes the texture and form of the horses as well as the wooden elements of the stable, imparting a sense of quiet, everyday life in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: Little Donkeys at Rest (Sosta di somarelli)
artworks.medium: etching on cream laid paper (artist's proof, printed with tone)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This image depicts two donkeys and a plow in a grassy field. The view is slightly elevated, showing the horizon in the upper third with a sky above. The etched lines create detailed textures in the scene, including the grass and clouds. The color palette is mostly shades of gray. In the distance, the field extends towards rolling hills, while clouds swirl overhead. The donkeys are resting in rich detail, drawing the viewer's focus with their contrast against the background.

artworks.title: a) Horses at Rest (recto); b) Horses at Rest (verso) (Sosta di cavalli)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (working proof, counterproof on verso)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two horses standing together in a landscape depicted in an etching style. The composition is viewed from a slightly elevated angle, with the horizon placed low. The details of the horses and surroundings are outlined with fine lines creating texture and depth. The color palette is predominantly gray and white, with hints of a distant landscape. The ground shows grass and uneven terrain, while the sky is subtly sketched with faint clouds.

artworks.title: a) Artillery on Mission (recto); b) Artillery on Mission (verso) (Artiglieria da campagna)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (artist's proof impressions on recto and verso)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a line of soldiers marching along a dirt road with a covered cart pulled by a horse nearby. The viewpoint appears to be at ground level, offering an eye-level perspective of the procession. The horizon is low, obscured by distant trees and the continuation of the road, which extends into the distance on the left side. The scene is depicted in a sketch-like style with fine lines and cross-hatching, resembling etching techniques. The color scheme is monochrome, utilizing shades of black and sepia to provide depth and texture for a historical appearance. Trees with sparse foliage line the path to the left, and additional trees and a hill-like structure are visible in the background.

artworks.title: Horse at Midday (Cavallo a meriggio)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (proof)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a horse standing near some trees on the right side. The horizon is not clearly defined as it merges with the sky filled with sparse foliage. The trees and horse create depth in the scene. The etching style is intricate, with fine lines depicting textures like the horse's fur, tree bark, and grass. The color palette is monochromatic with various shades of gray, creating a calm visual impact. The use of hatching and cross-hatching adds depth and realism. A wooden fence angles upward to the left in the foreground, with gently sloping terrain in the background.

artworks.title: Oxen Yoked to a Cart (Maremma) (Bovi al carro (Maremma))
artworks.medium: etching printed in brown with wash, touched with red chalk on wove cream paper (working artist's proof)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with grazing land, two oxen pulling a cart, a resting dog, haystacks, trees in the distance, and swirling clouds in the sky. The colors are sepia tones, and the style features detailed etching techniques with precise lines and shading.

artworks.title: Soldier with a Pail, Seen from Behind (Soldato di spalle con secchio)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper (artist's proof)
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection and Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back to the viewer, positioned facing away from the observer, slightly turned to the right. The person has short, slicked-back hair partially covered by a flat cap and is wearing a loose-fitting jacket, pants, and sturdy boots. They hold a wooden bucket in their right hand. In the background, there are tents pitched on a grassy and slightly uneven terrain, with a few other figures partially visible, sitting near the tents. There are horses near a covered wagon in the distance. The scene is set outdoors, with sparse blades of grass and small shrubs visible on the ground.

artworks.title: Reapers
artworks.medium: stipple and roulette on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 48.26 × 68.58 cm (19 × 27 in.), trimmed to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of the Krugman Family Foundation Fund and Anonymous Donor
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with reapers working in a field. A man on horseback is on the left, a woman holds a bundle of grain in the center, and other individuals are also reaping and bundling the harvest. A dog sits near agricultural tools and jugs. In the background, there is a faint silhouette of a spire, possibly representing a rural church or village structure. The landscape includes detailed trees and a horizon visible in the distance. The color palette is in muted sepia tones.

artworks.title: The Virgin of the Rosary with Saint Dominic and a Monk
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This drawing features a central, elevated figure being crowned, surrounded by numerous figures and angelic beings amidst an array of symbolic imagery. The detailed drawing depicts a woman holding a child, elevated on a pedestal, with an ornate crown being placed upon her head. The scene is surrounded by circular vignettes held by cherub-like figures. At the top, divine figures appear to be overseeing the coronation, gesturing outward. The composition is dense with figures, including kneeling figures and angelic beings holding drapery. The artwork is characterized by intricate details in the depiction of garments, expressions, and the circular scenes.

artworks.title: P. T. Barnum
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated from the waist up, with his body slightly turned to the side but facing the camera. The man has deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a firm mouth. He has curly dark hair with some thinning at the front. He is dressed in a dark suit, including a waistcoat and bow tie, over a white shirt. A pocket watch chain is visible hanging from his waistcoat. The bottom of the photograph is inscribed with "Barnum." The background is plain.

artworks.title: Edwin Booth
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Ronald and Kathleen Perisho
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated sideways with his hands on his lap. He is looking to his left, away from the camera. The man has distinct facial features, with a pronounced nose and deep-set eyes. He has dark, shoulder-length, slightly wavy hair and is wearing a suit jacket over a white shirt with a bow tie. The background is plain, and the image is bordered with decorative lines.

artworks.title: George Inness
artworks.medium: albumen silver print (carte-de-visite)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Funds from Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up. He is seated, with his body slightly turned to one side and his head facing forward. The man has medium-length wavy hair that falls around his ears and a beard with a mustache. He is wearing round wire-rimmed glasses, a dark suit jacket over a white shirt, and a dark bow tie. The jacket is buttoned, and a chain is visible across his vest. The background is plain and neutral. The border at the bottom of the photograph includes the photographer's name, "Brady," and the location, "New York."
